text_block_list.text:
It's time for Эйсин Флэш's second summer
camp,
her last and biggest chance to
gear up for the
autumn Tenno Sho.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The impending end to this journey
weighs heavily
on me, and I vow to
commit the sight of Eishin
Flash running
to my memory.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
